Read the One Star Reviews for Reality
May 2020
I've been to countless places in HCMC and even in Bui Vien but this place has to be the worst. The food is absolutely terrible, the service is atrocious. And I felt like the place was being run by underworld figures. Very shady place. Keep in mind that nearly all places on TA have 4-5 stars overall. Ask yourself how that's possible. We all know the deal with that. And TA will delete all comments that even hint that reviews cannot be trusted. You're best off only reading the 1 and 2 star reviews if you want reality. I wasn't scammed only because I was on guard before going there because I read the 1 star reviews which pointed out the possibility.
